title.text: G11 · Thread a moment as it is kept

pill.text:
After a capture on the walk screen or Navigate's ready screen, the Add to this moment pill gains Thread (the link icon), before ×, spoken "Add this moment to a thread". One tap opens the card for the whole moment.

Rests on MS2 as decision 0253 amends it. It does not: change the shutter (one tap), ask anything before a capture, add a count, colour or sound, or replace the editor that opens first (0240).

At 320 px five buttons do not fit left of the stack: three, then Thread and ×; every target stays 44 px.

Choice: Thread sits before ×, so Not now stays last.

group.text: With Group captures on (MS19, MS21) the pill gives way to "Adding to this moment" and New moment. Thread joins them, between the words and New moment; the words wrap to two lines. It threads the open moment, every piece with it.

card.text:
The thread you last added to is first, under "Last added to": one tap adds the moment. Then A new thread, then your threads, newest first. A search over threads (name or first words) and moments (words, place or date).

Recommended: the search closed until tapped, so the keys do not cover the first row. Other shape: open on the search with the keys up (your "little search bar"), Last added to still first above the keys.

Sizes are words ("a few moments"); the mark is the link of a thread you made (0105). Nothing is named or suggested for you.

moments.text:
A thread still needs two kept moments (0104, OT6). A new thread now lists the walk you are on, newest first; a photo or video shows its small picture beside its place and time, never alone. Pictures here are coloured stand-ins for yours.

Once two are joined, an optional name; empty is fine (headed by place and date, as today).

Choice: the words "Leave it unnamed" and "The two moments are a thread now."

A third mural then takes two taps: Thread, then the first row.

group2.text:
Found while building: beside Thread and New moment, "Adding to this moment" takes three lines at 390 px, not the two drawn (the real type, 15 pt semibold, in the room left of the stack).

Recommended: the line stacks as the Add to this moment pill does, its words on one line above Thread and New moment, its words unchanged (MS19).

Other shape: keep it as drawn and accept three lines.
